alt: PhotoLab project overview with source images and job state
caption: Project inputs and processing state.
what: Open the 135-image GCP validation project. Show the project tree, image list and jobs state without private paths.

alt: Aligned PhotoLab cameras and sparse point cloud
caption: Aligned cameras and sparse geometry.
what: Show the shared 3D viewer with aligned cameras, sparse cloud and GCP markers in the 135-image validation dataset.

alt: Dense point cloud generated in PhotoLab
caption: Dense point-cloud result.
what: Frame the completed dense point cloud from the 24-image smoke or approved golden dataset; include product identity and job completion.

alt: PhotoLab elevation model and orthomosaic result
caption: Elevation and orthomosaic products.
what: Show a split or two-pane inspection of the DEM and orthomosaic from the approved golden dataset, with resolution and CRS visible.

caption: Processing and accuracy evidence.
what: Open a populated processing report from a completed run. Show inputs, alignment, control/checkpoint residuals and product lineage.

alt: PhotoLab workflow from import to published products
caption: Import, align, inspect, generate and report.
what: Record a 20–30 second silent workflow: import summary, alignment result, product selection, job progress, completed products and report.

alt: Builder displaying a large point cloud in the shared viewer
caption: Point-cloud viewing in the current internal build.
what: Use the Alte Akademie validation project. Show the 96.6M-point cloud in perspective with the entity tree and status bar visible.

alt: Builder clipping a mixed spatial scene
caption: Section and clipping controls.
what: Use Alte Akademie. Show a locked clipping/section state through point cloud, terrain and IFC, with the active control visible.

caption: Ground extraction with preview and job state.
what: Show a selected cloud, the Extract ground panel, coarse preview and the Jobs island with meaningful progress.

alt: Breakline drafting with snapping in Builder
caption: Breakline drafting and snapping.
what: Capture only after implemented. Show a terrain edge, snap candidate, construction bar and committed breakline.

alt: Builder DGM creation window with source checks and error list
caption: DGM creation with checks before publication.
what: Open Create surface on a real scan. Show sources, roles, error list, one fix action and the checked preview.

alt: Builder export plan and loss review
caption: Export planning and loss review.
what: Show File Export after selecting a supported real document. Include target format, exact loss review and destination step.

alt: Builder point cloud to terrain workflow
caption: Point cloud to checked terrain and export.
what: Record a 20–30 second silent sequence: open cloud, segment/extract ground, create DGM, inspect errors, edit region and open export plan.
